facts.statement: Mystery Chest Series 2 added sci-fi themed loot items to Free Realms.
facts.quote: Mystery Chest Series 2 items are here, and they're out of this world!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Mystery Chests Series 2)
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post announcing the Sci-Fi 'Mystery Chest Series 2' loot release. It lists sample items inside the sci-fi chest, says Members can get a Flying Saucer ride, and explains that players can earn one of each chest (Original and Sci-Fi) daily and open them with a Mystery Key bought in the Marketplace. The post is undated beyond a relative 'Posted 3 days, 19 hours ago' stamp.
